Package index

Connect to a store

Create a store and connect to its primary and secondary locations.

store_connect()
Connect to a store
store_create()
Initialise an empty store
store_refresh()
Re-read the catalogs of a connection

Credentials

Credentials for Google Cloud Storage, set once per connection, and a check of every client.

rcs_auth_gcs() print(<rcs_auth_gcs>)
Credentials for Google Cloud Storage
store_auth_check()
Check which clients reach each location of a store

See what a store holds

These functions read the catalog only; they open no data file.

print(<rcs_store>)
Print a store connection
store_datasets()
List the datasets of a store
store_describe() print(<rcs_description>)
Describe one dataset
store_status() print(<rcs_status>)
Compare the locations of a connection with one of them
store_history()
List the versions of a dataset

Write

store_write()
Write a dataset to a store

Read

store_read()
Read a dataset
store_open() print(<rcs_query>)
Open a dataset as a lazy query
store_intersects()
Add a spatial filter to a lazy query
store_sample()
Sample rows of a dataset
store_glimpse()
A first look at a dataset
filter(<rcs_query>) select(<rcs_query>) mutate(<rcs_query>) rename(<rcs_query>) arrange(<rcs_query>) distinct(<rcs_query>) head(<rcs_query>) collect(<rcs_query>) compute(<rcs_query>) pull(<rcs_query>) glimpse(<rcs_query>)
dplyr verbs for lazy queries

DuckDB

The datasets of a store as DuckDB views, in memory or in a database file.

store_duckdb()
Query a store's datasets in DuckDB
store_tables()
List a store's datasets or a DuckDB connection's tables

Geospatial preparation

Add, index and strip the package’s geospatial columns in memory, without a store.

rcs_geo_add() rcs_geo_index() rcs_geo_strip()
Add, index and strip the package's geospatial columns

Types and H3 cells

H3 cells as 64-bit integers printed as hex, and the R types of data read by other tools.

rcs_h3
H3 cells as 64-bit integers, printed as hex
rcs_h3_hex()
Hex strings of H3 cells
store_h3_hex()
H3 cells as hex strings
store_restore_types()
Restore the R types of a dataset's columns

Check and maintain

Verify stored files, keep secondary locations up to date, remove old versions.

store_check()
Check a stored dataset
store_sync()
Bring the locations of a store into step
store_copy()
Copy one dataset between two locations
store_delete()
Delete a dataset
store_rebuild()
Rebuild the catalogs of a location
store_prune()
Remove old versions and orphan files

Simulated data

Generators of the simulated data used in examples, vignettes and tests.

rcs_sim_table()
Simulated table of daily sales
rcs_sim_polygons() rcs_sim_points() rcs_sim_lines() rcs_sim_raster()
Simulated geospatial data

Work counters

rcs_trace() rcs_trace_reset()
Work counters of the last call
